title: Ɛnne a Ɛwɔ Ansa na Ahum no Reba
intro: Onipa bi a ɔwɔ sare so sɔree sɛ ɔrebɛfrɛ ɔman a tumi wom asan aba nokware no mu. Ná wonim nkurɔfo no sɛ wɔn adan a ɛyɛ nwonwa ne wɔn ahoɔden a ɛso bi nni. Nanso wɔn ahantan no maa wɔn ani furae, na wɔpowee sɛ wobetie. Awiei koraa no, asotwe a ɛyɛ hu baa wɔn so, na ɛmaa gyidifo kuw ketewaa bi pɛ.
clues: Wɔsomaa me kɔɔ nnipa a wɔwɔ tumi a wɔtete asase a ɛda hɔ so na wonim wɔn sɛ wɔn ho yɛ den no nkyɛn.
Me nkurɔfo dii ɔman kɛse foforo a wɔasɛe no akyi.
Ná wɔwɔ adan a ɛyɛ nwonwa na wosisii abantenten atenten.
Mefrɛɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnsom Onyankopɔn Baako, nanso wɔpowee sɛ wobegyaw wɔn abosom.
Asotwe a emu yɛ den baa wɔn so, na ɛmaa wɔn a wɔne me gye dii no nkutoo.
Me ne deɛ wɔsomaa no kɔɔ nnipa a wɔyɛ den a wɔfrɛ wɔn Aad nkyɛn.

arabic: أَوَعَجِبْتُمْ أَن جَآءَكُمْ ذِكْرٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍۢ مِّنكُمْ لِيُنذِرَكُمْ ۚ وَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ إِذْ جَعَلَكُمْ خُلَفَآءَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ قَوْمِ نُوحٍۢ وَزَادَكُمْ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ بَصْۜطَةًۭ ۖ فَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ ءَالَآءَ ٱللَّهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
verse: Then do you wonder that there has come to you a reminder from your Lord through a man from among you, that he may warn you? And remember when He made you successors after the people of Noah and increased you in stature extensively. So remember the favors of Allāh that you might succeed." (7:69)
